name: Koukaishi to Koukogaku-sha Sennyuuroku
original_name: 航海士と考古学者の潜入録
source:
Nami and Robin, a navigator and an archaeologist in the pirate ship,
sneak into a slave ship to steal money and get a clue for a treasure.
However, they get trapped.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056871.html]DLsite English[/url]]
